description: Express is a small Node.js tool for handling web requests and sending replies. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.
versionNote: Examples use Express 5 and Node.js 20 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Reply to a request with Express.js
Read a query value with Express.js
Run a shared step with Express.js
Point to another route with Express.js
learningObjectives: Reply to a request with Express.js
Read a JSON body with Express.js
Say when an item is missing with Express.js
